claim: RPE is a layer of cells paved by hexagonal, brown-pigmented cells, which locates between the neural retina and the choroid.
source: RPE is a layer of cells paved by hexagonal, brown-pigmented cells, which locates between the neural retina and the choroid.

evidence: This claim is supported by citations to previous research (Kim et al., 2013; Lehmann et al., 2014; Lin et al., 2022).
